text: Can the pinch be proved from definitions in the formal kernel, rather than checked on integers?
description:
OP-09: a machine-checked proof of the dimension-eight pinch.

Known: the kernel proves the norm multiplicative for the complex numbers, quaternions and octonions.

Unknown: the converse of Hurwitz, and the pinch as a theorem.

Why it matters: R-FND-0002 claims less than "proof-checked" until it exists.

Scope: a formalization project, with the Hurwitz converse as the known hard part.

Skills: formal proof, algebra.

Where to start: Baez 2002, The Octonions; Conway and Smith 2003, On Quaternions and Octonions.

The claims it would move: R-FND-0002.

Evidence named: from-nothing hardening plan, tier 3.
